decisions.reason: As a low-cost addition close to the established offer with still-unresolved demand, it remains a cheap option to keep open.
The multi-release line's future upside is still uncertain and retention costs are manageable, so the option should stay open.
The jazz vinyl reissue builds on established strengths and is likely inexpensive to keep, so unresolved value justifies holding the option.
Although the box set is costlier to hold, its potential as a collectible leaves enough uncertainty to justify keeping the option open for now.
A low-cost compilation CD close to the existing offer has minimal downside, making it an easy option to retain.
